name: CL1 Linear / Kinetic Telemetry Atlas
boundaries: Simulation frame tick is not wall-clock sampling of an external instrument.
Animated kinetic particles show direction and relative speed proportional to simulated Q, not physical velocity in m/s.
Linear plots are derived from the same one deterministic Tero-inspired solver; no fabricated EEG, neuron telemetry, live sensors, laboratory measurements or external telemetry streams.
Kinetic means visible motion of software particles, not operation of a robot, weapon, neuron interface or physical actuator.
Ontology links and source records are those in the existing, source-qualified Physarum knowledge graph.

metrics.label: Absolute model flux
metrics.description: Sum of absolute signed edge flows. Not measured cytoplasmic speed.

metrics.label: Active conducting tubes
metrics.description: Count of unblocked edges above the simulator's visualization threshold.

metrics.label: Mean edge conductance
metrics.description: Arithmetic mean tube conductance over unblocked edges.

metrics.label: Quadratic flow index
metrics.description: Sum of squared edge flows, an illustrative cost proxy, not joules.

metrics.label: Directional motion index
metrics.description: Mean absolute edge flow driving on-screen particles; not physical velocity.

metrics.label: Flux change per simulation tick
metrics.description: Signed discrete difference from preceding recorded step. Not acceleration in m/s².

metrics.label: Pressure-range index
metrics.description: Difference between maximum and minimum unblocked solver pressures. Not pascals.
